use: Foam by sparging or stirring; a camera measures foam height, bubble size and decay (half-life).
simulation: Foaming efficiency set by dynamic surface tension; decay by a phenomenological drainage + coarsening (Ostwald) model.
notes: Commercial dynamic foam analyzer (modelled on KRÜSS DFA100: glass column + sintered-glass sparging / optional stirring + height camera + bubble-structure camera). Specs not individually verified.
sources: KRÜSS DFA100 product page: foam height over time, bubble size distribution (Foam Structure Module)
Evonik automated surface science lab (CoatingsTech 2025): sparging / shake-flask foaming + camera recording of generation and decay, benchmarked against Ross–Miles (ASTM D1173)

spec.column: Glass column, ID 40 mm, height 250 mm

sparge.description: Sparge foaming: gas at flow_mL_min for duration_s seconds (sintered glass / air stone)

stir.description: Stir foaming: stir at speed_rpm for duration_s seconds (only on models that support stirring)

measure.description: Take one shot: side-view foam height / liquid height, top-view mean bubble radius and area fraction of large bubbles (R > 0.5 mm)

record.description: Record continuously for duration_s seconds (one shot every interval_s seconds); at the end reports initial height and half-life (extrapolated from the decay shape if it has not dropped to half)

drain.description: Drain the foam column (liquid goes to the internal waste bottle)

rinse.description: Rinse the foam column with water `cycles` times

alternatives.model: self-built DIY foam rig (cylinder + air pump + webcam)
